text_en: These are the words that Moses spoke to all Israel beyond the Jordan—in the wilderness, on the plain opposite Suph, between Paran and Tophel, Laban, Hazeroth, and Di-zahab.
text_cn: 以下是梅瑟在约但河东岸，对全以色列所讲的话。──即在稣夫对面的阿辣巴旷野中，在帕兰与托费耳、拉班、哈则洛特和狄匝哈布之间。

text_en: (By the way of Mount Seir it takes eleven days to reach Kadesh-barnea from Horeb. )
text_cn: 从曷勒布经色依尔山，到卡德士巴尔乃亚，共有十一天的路程。──

text_en: In the fortieth year, on the first day of the eleventh month, Moses spoke to the Israelites just as the Lord had commanded him to speak to them.
text_cn: 在第四十年十一月一日，梅瑟将上主吩咐他的一切事，全训示了以色列子民。

text_en: This was after he had defeated King Sihon of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, and King Og of Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei.
text_cn: 当时他已击败住在赫市朋的阿摩黎王息红，和住在阿舍塔洛特和厄德勒的巴商王敖格。

text_en: Beyond the Jordan in the land of Moab, Moses undertook to expound this law as follows:
text_cn: 梅瑟在约但河东岸摩阿布地方开始宣讲这法律说：

text_en: The Lord our God spoke to us at Horeb, saying, “You have stayed long enough at this mountain.
text_cn: “上主，我们的天主，在曷勒布曾训示我们说：‘你们在这山下住得够久了，

text_en: Resume your journey, and go into the hill country of the Amorites as well as into the neighboring regions—the Arabah, the hill country, the Shephelah, the Negeb, and the seacoast—the land of the Canaanites and the Lebanon, as far as the great river, the river Euphrates.
text_cn: 现在起身出发，到阿摩黎人的山地去，到那些住在阿辣巴荒野、山地、盆地、乃革布和沿海一带地方去，到客纳罕地，到黎巴嫩，直到大河，即幼发拉的河那一带地方去。

text_en: See, I have set the land before you; go in and take possession of the land that I swore to your ancestors, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give to them and to their descendants after them. ”
text_cn: 看，我已将此地摆在你们面前，你们应去占领上主誓许给你们的祖先亚巴郎、依撒格、雅各伯和他们后裔的地方。’”

text_en: At that time I said to you, “I am unable by myself to bear you.
text_cn: 那时我对你们说过：我个人无法负担你们。

text_en: The Lord your God has multiplied you, so that today you are as numerous as the stars of heaven.
text_cn: 上主你们的天主使你们的人数增加，看，你们今天多得有如天上的繁星。

text_en: May the Lord , the God of your ancestors, increase you a thousand times more and bless you, as he has promised you!
text_cn: 惟愿上主你们祖先的天主，再千百倍地增加你们的数目，照他所应许的，祝福你们！

text_en: But how can I bear the heavy burden of your disputes all by myself?
text_cn: 但我个人怎能承担起你们的烦务、重任和诉讼的事？

text_en: Choose for each of your tribes individuals who are wise, discerning, and reputable to be your leaders. ”
text_cn: 你们各支派应推举一些有智慧，有见识，有经验的人，我好立他们为你们的首领。

text_en: You answered me, “The plan you have proposed is a good one. ”
text_cn: 你们回答我说：“你建议的事很好。”

text_en: So I took the leaders of your tribes, wise and reputable individuals, and installed them as leaders over you, commanders of thousands, commanders of hundreds, commanders of fifties, commanders of tens, and officials, throughout your tribes.
text_cn: 我遂选了你们各支派中有智慧有经验的首领，立为你们的首领：即千夫长、百夫长、五十夫长、十人长，并为各支派立了监督，

text_en: I charged your judges at that time: “Give the members of your community a fair hearing, and judge rightly between one person and another, whether citizen or resident alien.
text_cn: 同时我也吩咐你们的判官说：你们要听断你们兄弟间的诉讼：无论是兄弟彼此诉讼，或与外方人诉讼，都应秉公审断。

text_en: You must not be partial in judging: hear out the small and the great alike; you shall not be intimidated by anyone, for the judgment is God’s. Any case that is too hard for you, bring to me, and I will hear it. ”
text_cn: 审案时不可偏袒，无论贵贱，同样听断；任何人都不要怕，因为审判是天主的事。若遇有难断的案件，该呈报给我，我来听断。

text_en: So I charged you at that time with all the things that you should do.
text_cn: 同时，凡你们当做的事，我都吩咐了你们。

text_en: Then, just as the Lord our God had ordered us, we set out from Horeb and went through all that great and terrible wilderness that you saw, on the way to the hill country of the Amorites, until we reached Kadesh-barnea.
text_cn: 我们由曷勒布起程，经过了你们所见的这整个辽阔可怖的旷野：照上主我们的天主对我们的吩咐，我们向阿摩黎人山地进发，一直来到了卡德士巴尔乃亚。

text_en: I said to you, “You have reached the hill country of the Amorites, which the Lord our God is giving us.
text_cn: 那时我曾对你们说：你们已来到上主我们的天主即将赐给我们的阿摩黎人的山地。

text_en: See, the Lord your God has given the land to you; go up, take possession, as the Lord , the God of your ancestors, has promised you; do not fear or be dismayed. ”
text_cn: 看上主你的天主已将这地摆在你面前，你要照上主你祖先的天主对你所许下的，去占领这地；不要害怕，也不要胆怯。

text_en: All of you came to me and said, “Let us send men ahead of us to explore the land for us and bring back a report to us regarding the route by which we should go up and the cities we will come to. ”
text_cn: 你们众人便来到我跟前说：“让我们先派些人去，替我们侦探那地方，然后回报我们，我们当走哪条路，当去哪些城。”

text_en: The plan seemed good to me, and I selected twelve of you, one from each tribe.
text_cn: 我就由你们中挑选了十二人，每支派一人；

text_en: They set out and went up into the hill country, and when they reached the Valley of Eshcol they spied it out
text_cn: 他们起身上了山地，一直到了厄市苛耳山谷，侦探了那地。

text_en: and gathered some of the land’s produce, which they brought down to us. They brought back a report to us, and said, “It is a good land that the Lord our God is giving us. ”
text_cn: 他们带回来那地方的一些果品，并回报我们说：“上主我们的天主即将赐给我们的地方实在好。”

text_en: But you were unwilling to go up. You rebelled against the command of the Lord your God;
text_cn: 但你们却不肯上去，竟违背了上主你们天主的命令，

text_en: you grumbled in your tents and said, “It is because the Lord hates us that he has brought us out of the land of Egypt, to hand us over to the Amorites to destroy us.
text_cn: 在你们的帐幕内抱怨说：“上主因为恨我们，才将我们由埃及地领出来，将我们交在阿摩黎人手中，消灭我们。

text_en: Where are we headed? Our kindred have made our hearts melt by reporting, ‘The people are stronger and taller than we; the cities are large and fortified up to heaven! We actually saw there the offspring of the Anakim! ’”
text_cn: 我们上哪里去呢？我们的兄弟又说了些使我们心灰意冷的话。他们说：我们在那里看见了一个比我们又大又高的民族，他们的城邑广大，城墙高耸摩天；我们在那里还看见了阿纳克人的子孙。”

text_en: I said to you, “Have no dread or fear of them.
text_cn: 我遂对你们说：“不要畏惧，不要害怕。

text_en: The Lord your God, who goes before you, is the one who will fight for you, just as he did for you in Egypt before your very eyes,
text_cn: 因为上主你们的天主，走在你们前面，他必为你们作战，正如他在埃及在你们眼前，为你们所做的一样；

text_en: and in the wilderness, where you saw how the Lord your God carried you, just as one carries a child, all the way that you traveled until you reached this place.
text_cn: 并且在旷野里，你也看出上主你的天主在你所走的长途中，携带你们，如同人携带自己的儿子一样，直到你们来到这地方。”

text_en: But in spite of this, you have no trust in the Lord your God,
text_cn: 虽然如此，但你们仍不信赖上主你们的天主，

text_en: who goes before you on the way to seek out a place for you to camp, in fire by night, and in the cloud by day, to show you the route you should take. ”
text_cn: 他一路原走在你们前面，替你们找安营的地方：夜间藉着火，日间藉着云彩，指示你们应走的道路。

text_en: When the Lord heard your words, he was wrathful and swore:
text_cn: 上主一听见你们的怨声，就发怒起誓说：

text_en: “Not one of these—not one of this evil generation—shall see the good land that I swore to give to your ancestors,
text_cn: “这个邪恶世代的人，一个也不得见我誓许要赐给你们祖先的乐土；

text_en: except Caleb son of Jephunneh. He shall see it, and to him and to his descendants I will give the land on which he set foot, because of his complete fidelity to the Lord . ”
text_cn: 只有耶孚（fú）乃的儿子加肋布除外，他必见到此地，并且我要将他踏过的地，赐给他和他的子孙，因为他一心随从了上主。”

text_en: Even with me the Lord was angry on your account, saying, “You also shall not enter there.
text_cn: 为了你们的缘故，上主也对我发怒说：“连你也不能进入那地。

text_en: Joshua son of Nun, your assistant, shall enter there; encourage him, for he is the one who will secure Israel’s possession of it.
text_cn: 那侍候你的农的儿子若苏厄，要进入那地；你应壮他的胆，因为他要使以色列占领那地作为产业。

text_en: And as for your little ones, who you thought would become booty, your children, who today do not yet know right from wrong, they shall enter there; to them I will give it, and they shall take possession of it.
text_cn: 此外，你们所说要成为战利品的幼童，至今尚不知好歹的子女，他们都要进入那地。我要将那地赐给他们作为产业。

text_en: But as for you, journey back into the wilderness, in the direction of the Red Sea. ”
text_cn: 至于你们，应转向红海出发，往旷野里去。”

text_en: You answered me, “We have sinned against the Lord ! We are ready to go up and fight, just as the Lord our God commanded us. ” So all of you strapped on your battle gear, and thought it easy to go up into the hill country.
text_cn: 你们回答我说：“我们得罪了上主；现在我们愿全照上主我们的天主的吩咐上去交战。”你们各人遂都武装起来，轻率地上了山地。

text_en: The Lord said to me, “Say to them, ‘Do not go up and do not fight, for I am not in the midst of you; otherwise you will be defeated by your enemies. ’”
text_cn: 但上主对我说：“你告诉他们说：你们不要上去，不要作战，因为我不在你们中间，免得被敌人击败。”

text_en: Although I told you, you would not listen. You rebelled against the command of the Lord and presumptuously went up into the hill country.
text_cn: 我立即告诉了你们，你们却不听，违背上主的命令，擅自上了山地。

text_en: The Amorites who lived in that hill country then came out against you and chased you as bees do. They beat you down in Seir as far as Hormah.
text_cn: 住在山地的阿摩黎人蜂拥而出，攻击你们，追赶你们，由色依尔直杀到曷尔玛。

text_en: When you returned and wept before the Lord , the Lord would neither heed your voice nor pay you any attention.
text_cn: 你们回来，在上主面前哭泣哀号，但上主未曾俯听你们的哭声，也未向你们侧耳；

text_en: After you had stayed at Kadesh as many days as you did,
text_cn: 你们只得长期地停留在卡德士，停留得这样长久。
